essence: The practitioner should worship Indra and the other guardians of the directions in the outer square.
The practitioner should worship the vehicles of the direction-lords at their sides and their weapons outside.
One should offer a thousand oblations of pure sesame seeds soaked in ghee.
One should offer libations of the same number with white sesame seeds and likewise with black sesame seeds.
A mantra accomplished in this way bestows all desires.
